⬡ 01 — WHY NOWSmall companies are exposed, and nobody is checking.

AI-assisted attacks are getting faster, and most small companies have no security team. Before any tool can protect a company, someone has to know who has access to what, and whether it still matches who works there and what was approved. That is a records question, and records are what Zonar OS checks.

This is a gap check, not a monitoring service. It does not watch your systems around the clock, and it does not replace a security audit.

⬡ 02 — HOW IT WORKSZonar OS finds. HALU briefs. You decide.

STEP 1

Share

You export the records you choose, for example the staff list, the user-account list and payment approvals. NDA first. Read-only.

STEP 2

Compare

Zonar OS matches the files against each other: accounts against staff, dormant accounts, payments against approvals.

STEP 3

Brief

HALU writes a short plain-language brief for the owner of each gap: what was found, why it matters, what to do.

STEP 4

Decide and close

A named person approves each action. HALU follows up until the gap is closed and logged.

⬡ 03 — WHAT IT CHECKSThree checks to start.

Accounts against staff

Finds accounts that belong to people who are no longer on the staff list.

Dormant accounts

Finds accounts with no recent use that still hold access.

Payments against approvals

Finds payments with no matching approval on record.

⬡ 07 — QUESTIONSStraight answers.

Is this continuous monitoring?

No. It is a check on the records you export. It finds gaps at a point in time, and can be repeated on a schedule you agree.

Can the AI change our accounts on its own?

No. HALU suggests and briefs. A person approves every action that matters.

Do you connect to our systems?

Not in the pilot. We work from file exports you choose to share, after an NDA.

Where is our data held, and which standards apply?

These are set out in the Data Handling Note before any data is shared, including location, retention and access. We do not claim certifications we do not hold.

Is this a replacement for a security audit?

No. It finds record gaps that often sit behind security problems. For a wider view of AI readiness, start with the 5-day Executive AI Readiness Review.
